Name: White Kitty
Author: HilariousWolf97
Description: This mod requires Content Patcher for it to function and also SMAPI. This mod changes the cat to a white cat. You will need to pick the third cat model for this to work as I have not worked on the other models at the moment but I do plan to do so in the near future. Once installed, place it into the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley directory and run SMAPI.

Downloads.Description: Updated version as there was an issue with the sprite. Don't know if it is my PC or if people have noticed but thought I'd update to be sure

Manifest.Name: White Cat for Content Patcher
Manifest.Description: Changes cat to a Turkish Angora cat.
